Agent Name: Planner

Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified a conflict between sources based on search snippets rather than verifying the actual content of the authoritative pages, which led to an unnecessary loop to resolve a discrepancy that was largely resolved by the same sources upon deeper inspection.
